tokens: webapp/src/index.css (Tailwind scale, aliases, type role classes, shell surfaces)

meta.note: Version 2 redesigned the shipped UI; since then the web app is the source of truth. Where the app and this file differ, the app wins and this file is updated to match (tokens.css is what the apps load). Brand hues (navy #10325e, gold #eda41d, mist #e8ecf0) are unchanged.

tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: The page behind everything: the sidebar, the detail panel in light, the app's reading area in dark, landing sections. Dark is a neutral #191919.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Content on canvas: grouped lists, cards, panels, inputs. In light the app's reading area is surface (white) and the panes beside it sit on canvas; see the shell surfaces in docs/02-app.md.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Floating layers: menus, popovers, dialogs, toasts. In light it equals surface and relies on elevation-2/3; in dark it is one step lighter, because shadows do not read on black.

tokens.name: fill-quiet
tokens.usage: Hover rows, the segmented-control track, chips, icon tiles, skeletons, code spans, the user's chat bubble (as Tailwind `accent` and `muted`).

tokens.name: fill
tokens.usage: Pressed and selected rows (the current sidebar item), progress-bar tracks, secondary button pressed.

tokens.name: separator
tokens.usage: Hairlines: row dividers, the 1px border of cards, panels, menus and popovers, the top bar's bottom edge. Dark keeps the 10% white border.

tokens.name: control-border
tokens.usage: The 1px edge of inputs, outline buttons, grouped lists and entity cards. It now equals separator in both themes, so controls read as hairline-edged; focus and hover carry the affordance. (It was #7d8899 / #757575 at 3:1; the app moved to the lighter hairline.)

tokens.name: label
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on canvas, surface, surface-raised, fill-quiet, fill and every *-soft fill. Light is a navy-black ink, so body text carries the brand quietly; dark keeps the existing near-white foreground.

tokens.name: label-secondary
tokens.usage: Supporting text: row subtitles, descriptions, captions (the app's .type-caption and .type-meta are label-secondary), sidebar items at rest. 6.5:1 or better on canvas, surface and fill-quiet.

tokens.name: label-tertiary
tokens.usage: Least important legible text: timestamps, counts, placeholders, keyboard hints. 4.7:1 or better on canvas, surface and fill-quiet; never on fill.

tokens.name: tint
tokens.usage: The one interactive colour: primary buttons, links, switches on, selected options, the context ring, the strong fit band, unread and pending dots.

tokens.name: tint-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of a tint fill. on-tint stays legible on it.

tokens.name: tint-soft
tokens.usage: Secondary buttons, the active row in a list (bg-tint-soft), info pills and banners, text selection. Text on it is tint or label.

tokens.name: on-tint
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a tint or tint-hover fill. Dark is navy-black because the dark tint is light.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: a solid 2px ring outside a 2px gap in the ground colour. 6:1 or better on every surface.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Graduator navy, the logo's ink. Big identity fields only: deck cover and section slides, the landing page's closing band, the logo-on-navy tile. Never for small text or controls. Dark lifts it so a navy block still separates from canvas.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text on a brand field. 12.8:1 on brand in light, 10:1 in dark.

tokens.name: on-brand-secondary
tokens.usage: Supporting text on a brand field (deck subtitles, footers on navy). 6.6:1 on brand in light, 7.4:1 in dark.

tokens.name: gold
tokens.usage: The compass needle. One gold moment per view: the top match marker, a deck's key number, the mascot's cap. A fill or mark, never text on light grounds (2.1:1 on white); label or brand text sits on it. As text it is allowed only on a brand field (kickers on deck covers, eyebrows in the navy tile): 6:1 in light, 4.7:1 in dark.

tokens.name: gold-ink
tokens.usage: Gold when it must be text: landing eyebrows, the 'Best fit' label. 5.3:1 or better on surface, canvas and gold-soft.

tokens.name: gold-soft
tokens.usage: Ground for saved-record chips and the best-fit highlight. Text on it is label or gold-ink.

tokens.name: mist
tokens.usage: The logo's paper. Light panels on brand fields in the deck; never a UI surface (use canvas).

tokens.name: positive
tokens.usage: Done, approved, offer, sent. Text and dot on positive-soft and surface. Always with a word; success and critical are told apart by the word, not the hue.

tokens.name: positive-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of a positive status pill.

tokens.name: caution
tokens.usage: Paused, applying, deadline soon, budget near its cap. Text and dot on caution-soft and surface.

tokens.name: caution-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of a caution pill and of an inline warning banner.

tokens.name: critical
tokens.usage: Errors, rejected, destructive actions (text button or fill with on-critical). Text on critical-soft and surface.

tokens.name: critical-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of a critical pill and of an error banner.

tokens.name: on-critical
tokens.usage: Text on a critical fill (the confirm button of a destructive dialog).

tokens.name: fit-strong
tokens.usage: Fit score bar, strong band (45% and up, as api/candidates/scoring.py SCORE_BANDS). Fit is a measure, not a verdict, so it is one hue in three lightnesses, never traffic-light colours.

tokens.name: fit-moderate
tokens.usage: Fit score bar, moderate band (30 to 45%). 3.8:1 or better on surface; the band's name is always shown beside large bars.

tokens.name: fit-weak
tokens.usage: Fit score bar, weak and unrelated bands (under 30%). Follows control-border, so it is a hairline-grey bar; the percentage beside it drops to label-tertiary.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Behind the phone bottom sheet (popovers under 640px) and the docked Gradis panel on narrow screens. Dialogs use plain black at 50% with no blur.

tokens.name: material
tokens.usage: Translucent bars: the landing header and, as --app-main-material (white at 72% in light, this token in dark), the app's 48px top bar. Both use blur-thin.

families.mono: ui-monospace, "SF Mono", "JetBrains Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace

styles.name: hero
styles.sample: Find the professor, not just the programme.
styles.usage: One per page or slide: the landing hero and the deck cover. Scales to 56/60 under 768px and 44/48 under 480px. Italic for the one word that turns the sentence.

styles.name: statement
styles.usage: Deck statement slides and the landing page's single pull-statement band. Never in the app.

styles.name: quote
styles.sample: “I found my supervisor in a week, not a semester.”
styles.usage: Testimonials, a professor's paper title when quoted as evidence, the deck's customer voice slide.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Landing section headlines and deck slide titles. 40/44 under 768px.

styles.name: title-1
styles.usage: Secondary marketing pages (pricing, FAQ) and large numbers on deck metric slides.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: Graduator reads their papers, ranks them by fit and drafts the first email.
styles.usage: The paragraph under a hero or section headline, in label-secondary. 19/28 under 768px.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Sentence case, gold-ink, above a hero or section headline. Replaces the old 11px uppercase eyebrow.

styles.name: title-2
styles.usage: App page titles (Dossier, Outbox, Applications), one per page.

styles.name: title-3
styles.usage: Dialog titles, detail-panel titles, a professor's name on their page, feature-tile titles on the landing page.

styles.name: headline
styles.usage: Row and card titles, section headers inside a page, button labels at lg size.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Ten candidates matched your interests in robot learning.
styles.usage: Default interface text: chat, descriptions, form values.

styles.name: reading
styles.sample: Dear Professor Shi, I read your 2024 paper on agile quadruped control and…
styles.usage: Long-form text people read rather than scan: email drafts, Markdown answers, legal pages, landing body copy. Max line length 68ch.

styles.name: callout
styles.sample: Carnegie Mellon University, Robotics Institute PhD
styles.usage: Row subtitles, field hints, metadata lines, button labels at md size (weight 500).

styles.name: footnote
styles.usage: Timestamps, counts, sidebar meta, table cells in dense views.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Status pills, badges, tooltip text, chart axes. The smallest size: nothing goes below 12px (the old 10 and 11px steps are retired).

styles.name: numeral
styles.usage: Fit percentages, counts and money. Set with font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums in the sans, not in mono.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: API keys, model ids, code in Markdown, the keyboard hint inside a kbd. Not for numbers in the interface.

spacing.note: A 4px grid. Interface layouts use space-1 to space-12; marketing and deck rhythm uses space-16 and up.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label inside a pill, the inset of a segmented control and a menu.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Icon to label in buttons, gap between inline chips.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Row vertical padding, gap between toolbar controls.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Row horizontal padding, card padding in dense lists, page gutter on phones.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding, dialog body padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between grouped lists, dialog header padding, page gutter on tablets.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Page gutter on desktop, gap between a page title and its first group.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Gap between page sections in the app.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Top padding of app pages under the toolbar; gap between a landing headline and its visual.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Deck slide margin at 1920x1080; landing section padding on phones.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Landing section padding on tablets.

tokens.name: space-32
tokens.usage: Landing section padding on desktop: generous space is what makes the page feel calm.

radius.note: Concentric: an element inside another takes the outer radius minus the inset between them (a 14px menu with a 4px inset holds 10px items).

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Checkboxes, kbd hints, code spans, progress bars under 4px tall.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Status pills, badges, row-menu triggers, the user bubble's tail corner.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Controls: buttons, inputs, menu items, sidebar rows, popover options, icon buttons.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Grouped lists, entity cards, menus, the chat composer, banners, empty-state panels, attachment chips.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Dialogs, popovers, settings and usage panels (bordered cards), chat bubbles, the floating Gradis chat, the docked detail panel.

tokens.name: radius-2xl
tokens.usage: The phone bottom sheet's top corners, landing panels and deck panels.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Capsules: the sidebar's New run, marketing CTAs, composer chips and control pills, send and stop buttons, the context ring, avatars, switches, dots.

shadow.note: Depth is for things that float. Resting content is separated by surface against canvas, not by shadow.

tokens.name: elevation-1
tokens.usage: Tailwind shadow-xs, shadow-sm and shadow. Empty and error panels, skeleton cards, the auth card, a hovered entity card. Resting cards and panels use a 1px separator border instead. In dark it is a hairline, not a shadow.

tokens.name: elevation-2
tokens.usage: Tailwind shadow-md and shadow-lg. Menus, popovers, tooltips, toasts, the scroll-to-latest button. Menus and popovers also draw a 1px separator border.

tokens.name: elevation-3
tokens.usage: Tailwind shadow-xl and shadow-2xl. Dialogs, the floating Gradis chat, the docked Gradis panel on narrow screens, the landing product frame.

size.note: Fixed dimensions that keep the app, site and deck aligned.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Small buttons (Sort, Filters, row actions); icon buttons in toolbars and chat are 28px too.

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Default button, input, select and segmented-control height in the app.

tokens.name: control-lg
tokens.usage: Primary actions in dialogs and onboarding; the minimum touch target on phones.

tokens.name: control-xl
tokens.usage: Marketing CTAs (capsule).

tokens.name: sidebar-width
tokens.usage: The app sidebar's default width; people can drag it between 200 and 440px.

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Max width of app list pages (Matches, Schools, Applications, Outbox), with 16px gutters (24px from 640px).

tokens.name: reading-max
tokens.usage: Landing body copy. The app's reading columns (legal pages, the new-run page, wizards) use Tailwind max-w-2xl, 672px; the chat column on the Gradis page is 768px (max-w-3xl).

tokens.name: site-max
tokens.usage: Landing page content width; full-bleed bands ignore it.

blur.note: Backdrop blur radii for translucent materials.

tokens.name: blur-thin
tokens.usage: The app's top bar and the landing header, over material.

tokens.name: blur-regular
tokens.usage: Reserved; no current consumer.

tokens.name: blur-thick
tokens.usage: Reserved; no current consumer.

duration.note: Motion is quick and physical: things settle, they do not bounce. All motion stops under prefers-reduced-motion.

tokens.name: duration-instant
tokens.usage: Bundle hover and press colour changes. App hovers use Tailwind's default 150ms transition-colors.

tokens.name: duration-quick
tokens.usage: Tooltips (2px rise), switches, sidebar collapse and the dialog scrim fade (200ms).

tokens.name: duration-standard
tokens.usage: Dialogs rise 8px and fade.

tokens.name: duration-slow
tokens.usage: Landing reveals, the progress bar and score bars filling in.
